mandate: C402 — test the cross-sectional intraday TSCALE: MULTI-SCALE TAIL-EXPONENT (HILL) x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. TSCALE scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing log returns X=r[t-W+1..t] ending at bar t: sort |X| descending a_(1)>=...>=a_(W); for k in {12,24,48} fit the Hill tail-index alpha_k = k / sum_{i=1..k} ln(a_(i)/a_(k+1)); signals tscale_alpha12, tscale_alpha24, tscale_alpha48 (smaller alpha = fatter tail) and tscale_slope = (alpha_12 - alpha_48) / ln(48/12) (scale-dependence / departure from a pure Pareto law). NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in window, a_(k+1)<=0, denominator<=0, or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 4 real (tscale_alpha12/24/48_dev, tscale_slope_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar return window or a_(k+1)<=0 or denominator<=0 or not finite).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing log returns X=r[t-W+1..t] ending at bar t: sort |X| descending; Hill alpha_k = k / sum(ln(a_i/a_(k+1))) for k in {12,24,48}; tscale_slope=(alpha_12-alpha_48)/ln(48/12).
methodology.signals: tscale_alpha12/24/48/slope over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.tscale_vectorization_note: tscale Hill scalars via sliding_window_view(abs(X), 256) + np.partition top-k + cumulative log-sums per-asset; validated against brute-force per-window Hill fit with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests. Per-asset metric computation parallelized via ProcessPoolExecutor.
